name: fo-property-transfer-registration
description: Calculate Faroese property-transfer duty and mortgage-registration duty for 2026 instruments, keeping the percentage tax separate from the per-document registry fee. Covers ordinary purchases, gifts, exchanges, inheritance relief, principal increases, additional property security and the conditional replacement-loan relief. Supplies statutory paper instrument fields, approved-form requirements, witnessing, documentary authority, payment, priority, rejection, refund and appeal steps. Screens acquisition permission and declarations for individuals and companies. Trigger on Faroe Islands property purchase, skeyti, pantibræv, tinglýsingaravgjald, mortgage refinancing and title registration costs. Marks the unavailable current blank mortgage template, mixed gift/sale base as unresolved. Vehicle title retention, cadastral subdivision, property income tax and estate duty need their own methods and are not declared covered by this Guide.
